title: Rushing River Weir and Forested Hillside, 1930s Outdoor Nature Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical black-and-white snapshot capturing a low-head dam or weir across a river, with water cascading over into bright, foaming rapids below. The grassy riverbank occupies the immediate foreground, while the background is framed by a dense, sloping hillside forest of deciduous trees under natural daylight. A numeric stamp 'A83' appears in the corner on the reverse.
